title: Coin pickups
prompt: Add a coin pickup mechanic to this game. Every player gets a leaderstats folder with an IntValue named "Coins" starting at 0. Place at least 5 gold coin Parts (each named "Coin", anchored, CanCollide false) inside a Folder named "Coins" in Workspace, reachable from the spawn. When a player's character touches an active coin, that player's Coins increases by exactly 1 and that coin becomes inactive (invisible and not collectable) for 5 seconds, then comes back. Verify it in a running game.
